title: kbs prints a SUGGESTION footer after every create and comment; add a way to silence it for agents
description:
Every kbs create, comment and update prints a trailing SUGGESTION block (for example 'SUGGESTION: Markdown formatting is supported...' and the diagram hint with a kbs update example). Agents run kbs hundreds of times per day and these lines are added to their context each time, and they also make output parsing noisier.

Proposal: honour an environment variable (for example KANBUS_QUIET=1) and a --quiet flag that suppress the suggestions, keeping the one-line result. Acceptance: with the flag set the output of create, comment and update is only the result lines; Gherkin scenario; documented in CONFIGURATION.md.
right_now_summary: The issue proposes a quiet flag and environment variable to suppress suggestion footers from kbs output.
